analyst_view.overall: RB Salzburg are 26th with 4 points and coach Danny Röhl says the aim is 'clearly three points' against Ararat-Armenia, who are last with no points and 14 goals conceded in four games, though they beat Van 2-1 on Friday and have lost only once in the Armenian league. Salzburg lost 1-0 at Austria Wien on Sunday, Konate missing an early penalty and the side making few clear chances after the first half-hour. Their absentees (Tabakovic, Schmid, Boma, Kitano, Mellberg, Omoregie, with Redzic doubtful) are all in the numbers, as is Ararat's banned keeper João Bravim; Morgalla is now also doubtful with a shoulder problem while captain Veratschnig is close to a return, which roughly evens out at right-back. Only about 8,000 tickets were sold, so the Red Bull Arena will be two-thirds empty. Dutch referee Lawrence Visser is named and his high card rate is already counted; I keep the numbers except a small trim to shots on target.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals, 1.5 for Salzburg, already taking off Tabakovic, Redzic and Kitano and adding for Ararat playing without first-choice keeper Bravim (Nersesyan should deputise). Ararat concede plenty in Europe and Salzburg must win, but both are things the numbers already see, so I stay at about 2.6.

corners.text: The numbers expect 8.6 corners, 5.3 for Salzburg. Sports Mole expects Lindstrom and Vertessen on the wings with Ararat sitting deep, the pattern the numbers already assume, and losing a central striker changes who finishes moves more than how often Salzburg reach the byline, so I stay at about 8.6.

cards.text: The numbers now say 5.4 cards, adding about 27% for referee Lawrence Visser's 6.2 cards a game and a little for Ararat's busy recent card count. Both are already counted; a quiet, two-thirds-empty stadium and a side expected to dominate the ball give no reason to go higher, so I stay at about 5.4.

shots.text: The numbers expect 29.7 shots, 18.8 for Salzburg, already adding for their busy recent attack. Against a bottom side with a reserve keeper Salzburg should still have the ball and shoot often even without Tabakovic, so volume should hold and I stay at about 30.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.4 shots on target, adding for Salzburg's sharp recent shooting; their missing players only change the goals number, not this one. I trim slightly to about 10.0: much of that accuracy came through Tabakovic, and without him in Vienna Salzburg made few clear chances after Konate's saved penalty.
